title: The testing queue

blocked_on.what: A queue of runs that land nothing durable is faster waste.

note: The operator's original ask: 'always tests running, maximizing the infrastructure we have.' [!] IT GOES LAST ON PURPOSE -- a queue keeping runners busy against a fee-only corpus and a 3.5-day fixture manufactures wrong answers faster. Capacity is NOT the constraint; results not becoming decisions is, and E3-E7 fix that. Idle capacity that exists: GitHub-hosted runners, free for this repo.
